new_senses.gloss: sich hilfesuchend an jemanden wenden, Schutz suchen (mit su-);
new_senses.rationale: After the maphrian refuses permission, the man turns to Abdal Agha, whose intended role is explicitly waṣiṭa to obtain permission. One attestation supports recourse to a protector or mediator; it does not by itself prove physical asylum.

added_examples.turoyo: W lu Mafəryono lə mraxaṣle b haṯe. Hedi azze mḥalaqle ruḥe, məltaǧele su qašyano d ʕAbdal Aġa. <...>
added_examples.translation: And the maphrian did not allow him this. Then he went, threw himself, sought refuge with that cruel man Abdal Agha. <...>
added_examples.rationale: The sole occurrence gives the refusal followed by recourse to a named protector; new stem and Preterit example, with no invented Infectum. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; meaning is established from the Turoyo.
